---
description: "Use when user asks to align code with project rules, established instructions, hardening, or full compliance review."
---
# Compliance Mode

- When user requests alignment with rules, evaluate all relevant domains before coding.
- Required minimum sweep: engineering, workflow, database/data, security, reliability, testing, documentation, delivery, and quality/UI.
- For each domain report: `applicability`, `status`, `gap`, and `proposed fix`.
- If a domain is not applicable, state `not applicable` with a brief reason.
- Apply only approved fixes and then re-check impacted domains.
- Finish with a concise compliance summary and residual risks.
